dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid symmetric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, resulting in a sharp triangular termination of the visible body mass.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical bulge observed on the viewer-left lateral margin near the mid-section, while the opposing margin appears relatively linear.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel value across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low frequency; localized dark-pixel distribution is restricted to a single thin, longitudinal line on the posterior-right dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp gradient between the depigmented baseline and the dark linear anomaly; diffuse transitions at the lateral water-skin interfaces.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, dark linear mark extending longitudinally on the right side of the posterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible thin, dark linear scar or rake mark on the posterior-right dorsal quadrant.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent blowhole aperture with a high-contrast dark interior centered in the anterior region.
